summary: Each edition was independently reviewed against all six paragraphs of the selected Greek source. Both preserve the stone groups, contextual distinction between repentance and adverse reconsideration, inability to fit this tower, lesser-place fitting after torment and completion of the days of sins, the stated reason for transfer, and both final conditions and negations. The simplified edition does not introduce a concrete fidelity defect through its shortened clauses. The notes retain the disclosed working readings and accurately reflect the supplied bounded reports, distinguishing corrections, editorial proposals and supplies from preserved text, and mediated Ethiopic evidence from direct collation. Acceptance concerns fidelity to the supplied working source and evidence disclosures; it does not authenticate unseen manuscripts, certify editions, or establish exhaustive collation or uniquely correct interpretations.
